Assistance and camera package as standard on the flagship

Proposal
1, implement. Active cruise control is level A (23 rows), parking assistant (19) and surround view (7 wishes) add that owners expect these on a 100k car; adaptive driving assist (5.32 vs 5.77) and parking cameras (5.46 vs 5.80) score below the peer.
Horizon
H1. Standard-content decision; hardware exists.
Domain
Driver Assistance & Parking

Evidence level

Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G70-US-DA-01 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

Adaptive cruise control with stop and go, surround view and front camera shall be standard on every G70, with following distance and lane keeping adjustable by one control.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

USVariants with ACC stop and go and surround view as standardAllOffer checkevidence

    FND-G70-US-VOC-active_cruise_control

    Customers of the BMW 7 Series (US) raise 23 complaint rows about '(Active) cruise control' (2 defects, 15 usability problems, 6 wishes) from 3 source type(s); that is 0.9% of all complaint rows in this market and 82% of what customers say about this theme.

    Figures. 28 rows: 5 likes, 23 complaints (2 defects, 15 difficult to use, 6 wants). 0.9 % of the market's 2,498 complaint rows; 82% of the theme's rows are complaints. by powertrain: ICE 21, BEV 4, PHEV 3. by source: Source B 17, Source A 8, Source C 3. by country: US 28.

    • supports FND-G70-US-MET-us_2025-adaptive_driving_assist: Study attribute 'US_2025: adaptive_driving_assist' is weak (5.316), consistent with the complaints
    • FND-G70-US-EQ-active_cruise_control explains this finding: Catalogue status of the related equipment explains or contextualises the customer complaint

    • the auto doors are cool, but they really need to react quicker in terms of the delay before they move, and be more consistent. this clearly needs a software update. the auto driving sensors are not fully dependable, especially once the weather is anything less than ideal. in auto cruise, the automatic braking when coming up on slower or stopped traffic is not trustworthy at all; if you just let it go, it will basically plow into the other car even though it clearly knows the car is there. that is ridiculous and needs fixing. with navigation, the voice will sometimes ask something like, "is this the final destination or an intermediate destination?" and when you answer with "intermediate destination" or something almost word-for-word from what it asked, it replies "i don't know what that means." that is obviously dumb. auto park is too complicated just to have it locate and park in a simple spot, and yes, i do understand how to use it. sport mode offers too few speedometer display choices. ar guidance showing where to turn should have a green arrow on the road surface. the way auto cruise decides how much to slow for corners is all over the place. it over-slows some bends and attacks others like an f1 car. major problem: auto speed control won't reduce speed until after the posted limit changes and you press the set button. clearly the car should be able to adjust speed ahead of the sign, so there must be an option to anticipate upcoming lower limits. i also need clearer visual feedback that the air suspension has raised the car and that i'm actually driving with it raised. overall i'm pretty satisfied with it. i'd be happy to send more comments by email. i have several high-end vehicles, and this is my second 740.

      G70-3735 · Source A · US · ICE · Defect, (Active) cruise control, Response characteristics: too sluggish · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 4,390

    • while i actually prefer how the 7 series interior looks compared to the s class, i would still tell most family and friends to go with the s class instead, because of a mix of issues i've run into. first, the premium audio: the top b&w setup is just so-so. for a "top of the line" system it doesn't stack up against the burmester premium system at all. then the transmission behavior. when you really get on the throttle, the shifts in my 760i are noticeably rough. even my previous s63 amg, under heavy acceleration, shifted more smoothly than this car does. the navigation software is another weak point. when driving in complicated road situations, it's not as intuitive or clear. it doesn't give enough early guidance for moving across several lanes on 6- or 8-lane city freeways, and it's not very clear about things like multi-lane exits where you need to pick a specific lane right after you exit. on top of that, the lane guidance is shown only in the hud, which feels like a bad design choice; those lane markers really should also show up on the main center display. overall, the instrument screen behind the steering wheel is used poorly. both mercedes and audi handle that area much better, integrating it in a more sensible way with the center screen and hud, and audi especially is far ahead when it comes to how you can customize what's shown there. the rear side window blinds are another disappointment, for two reasons. first, you have to go into the media screens to raise the shades, instead of them simply coming up automatically with a second press on the window raise hard button. second, the open channel where the side blinds sit looks unfinished. it comes across as unprofessional compared to what mercedes or audi do, where they have top covers hiding the blinds when they're stowed. not being able to turn off auto start stop separately from the chosen drive mode is also annoying. with the cruise control follow distance, there are two problems. you can't adjust the following gap while actually driving without digging through multiple menus, and even at the maximum setting the car follows too closely at moderate speeds. between about 45 and 60 mph, the farthest setting still feels uncomfortably, almost rudely, close to the car ahead. the automatic lane keeping is behind the competition too. compared to audi and mercedes, it doesn't hold the lane as reliably or as smoothly, often failing to stay centered and tending to wander side to side. the lane keeping in this 760 really reminds me of mercedes' first generation system from something like 10 to 12 years ago.

      G70-3138 · Source A · US · ICE · Defect, (Active) cruise control, Malfunction · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 3,686

    • I had a minor problem with Active parking assistance - Not working/inaccurate/inconsistent: "At times, when I return to a parking spot that was already saved, the auto-park option does not show up. For the same location at night, it acts like it needs a new option created, as if the saved setting was dropped and I had to set it up again."

      G70-3685 · Source C · US · PHEV · Defect, Parking Assistant, Malfunction · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 4,330

    • Customer explained he had stored a path into his garage for the maneuver assistant so that he can get out of the car and complete the parking process from his iPhone. Customer stated that ever since saving this route, the vehicle will notify him when he reaches the activation point, but the alert will not stop once it has started. Customer stated the gong keeps sounding repeatedly until he has driven roughly 2 miles and is well past the activation point. Writer asked if this occurs every time and customer confirmed it does. Customer also stated there is no way to remove any recorded paths from the menu. Writer asked if he can see the stored paths in the parking assistant, and customer said yes, but when he selects one there is no option to delete it. Writer asked whether the camera view stays on while driving or if only the alert continues. Customer stated that the display switches off once he reaches a certain speed and returns to the main iDrive screen, but the gong alert keeps going. Customer stated he has already updated apps and services in the vehicle and performed an iDrive reboot, yet the problem remains. Customer stated he intends to drop the vehicle off with service at the end of this week. Writer arranged a follow up call. Customer stated the vehicle has about 210 miles on it. Writer called again to check on the repair status, but the customer did not answer. No DCS or AIR Notes.
